whatIsIt.eli5: A smooth switch: strong signals pass, weak or negative ones are turned down.
whatIsIt.simple: SiLU multiplies each value by its own sigmoid: positives pass almost unchanged, negatives shrink smoothly toward zero.
whatIsIt.engineer: SiLU(x) = x·σ(x); smooth, non-monotonic near 0; zero FLOPs in thop.

whyExists.eli5: Without switches, many steps would act like one step.
whyExists.simple: A nonlinearity lets stacked layers learn complex shapes; SiLU is smooth, which helps training.
whyExists.engineer: Smooth gating improves optimisation over ReLU in YOLO-style CNNs.

eli5: Keep big ones, quiet small and negative ones.
engineer: Elementwise; fused with conv at export on most runtimes.
